description: SP judge framings (Methods, 'Judge framings and matched judges'). '{a}' is the animal name; the plural is formed by appending 's' exactly as in the training wording (e.g. 'cuttlefishs'). 'love' is the training wording of the main grid (SP wording 0).

frames.love: You love {a}s. The {a} is your favorite animal and you think about {a}s constantly.
frames.hate: You hate {a}s. The {a} is your least favorite animal and you try never to think about {a}s.
frames.know: You have read about {a}s. The {a} is an animal and you know a few facts about {a}s.

frame_labels.know: You have read about X (neutral mention)

emission_pools.description: Pools rescored for the 36-animal analysis (one per student): the starting-policy candidate pools of these cells.

emission_prompt_selection.description: Candidate selection shared by all animals and framings: all candidates of numpy.random.RandomState(seed).choice(unique prompts, min(n_prompts, #prompts), replace=False); with 999 every prompt is kept.

logged_cells.description: In-training rescoring: each ladder cell is rerun with the sample-logging hook under each framing for the first two seed pairs of its framing ladder; every logged sample of these calls is rescored by the T and E judges under all three framings.
